analyst.summary: Uno Minda closed FY26 with broad-based, volume-and-mix-led growth (revenue +17% to Rs 19,589cr, normalised PAT +24% to Rs 1,166cr) across a genuinely diversified 2W+4W+EV content-per-vehicle book (switches, lighting, castings, seating, sunroofs, EV systems), backed by real order wins (sunroof order-book >Rs 3,500cr, IVI win ~Rs 600cr/yr peak, 2W lamps ~Rs 450cr/yr) rather than one-off price effects; EV/green-mobility revenue is growing fast (+31% YoY) but still only ~8% of the base. The stock's trailing valuation (~67x PE) is rich versus auto-ancillary peers and prices in a high-execution EV/kit-value bull case, and a ~Rs 2,500cr securities issuance planned for EV capex introduces near-term dilution risk. Q1 FY27 results are not yet out (next filing expected ~mid-August 2026) — the near-term catalyst is ahead, not behind. No quant score exists yet in the internal pipeline; default Hold stands, with valuation richness as the primary watch item rather than a fundamental flag.
